build_profile: debug, default features, offline locked; exact Task 014 Cargo JSON artifact resolver

exclusions.irrelevant: CURRENT, PACKING, TRAIN, FOOD, IRRELEVANT minus expected labels

corpus_hash_basis: UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, compact separators, no trailing newline
limits: five-case synthetic lexical ContextCapsule conformance after restart; no general/model-answer quality, semantic retrieval, cross-session recall, live tokens/cost, superiority or v0.1 readiness claim

measurement_basis.comparison: sequential fresh stores: 0 then N unrelated session memories; same frozen corpus and repetitions per query
measurement_basis.context: exact serde_json ContextCapsule bytes captured by test driver, reconciled with durable model.requested
measurement_basis.latency: CLI spawn through terminal JSON; no warmup discarded; recovered memory listing precedes queries
measurement_basis.startup: spawn to health readiness; 10 ms polling; recovery after abrupt process kill, not power loss
measurement_basis.storage: live logical file sizes including WAL/SHM; fixture logs separately counted; excludes server stdout log

model_settings: cfg(test) offline-baseline-fixture; zero-delay fixed answer; no usage; no production provider selection
